_note: 26 base-game bonus cards as structured conditions (own words). Tiers: [min birds, points]; the highest tier reached scores (rules.md W13). 'per': points per qualifying bird. Values checked against Wingsearch bonus.json and the BoardGameGeek card list; differences resolved in rules.md W15 (D3 Photographer, D4 Backyard Birder, D5 Anatomist).

cards.name: Anatomist
cards.describe: Birds with a body part in their name (beak, belly, bill, breast, cap, chin, collar, crest, crown, eye, face, head, neck, rump, shoulder, tail, throat, wing)

cards.name: Backyard Birder
cards.describe: Birds worth less than 4 points

cards.name: Bird Counter
cards.describe: Birds with the flocking icon

cards.name: Bird Feeder
cards.describe: Birds that eat seed (seed icon in the cost)

cards.name: Breeding Manager
cards.describe: Birds with at least 4 eggs on them

cards.name: Cartographer
cards.describe: Birds with a place name in their name (American, Atlantic, Baltimore, California, Canada, Carolina, Chihuahuan, Eastern, Inca, Mississippi, Mountain, Northern, Prairie, Sandhill, Savannah, Western)

cards.name: Ecologist
cards.describe: Birds in your habitat with the fewest birds

cards.name: Enclosure Builder
cards.describe: Birds with a ground (or star) nest

cards.name: Falconer
cards.describe: Birds with the predator icon

cards.name: Fishery Manager
cards.describe: Birds that eat fish

cards.name: Food Web Expert
cards.describe: Birds that eat only invertebrates

cards.name: Forester
cards.describe: Birds that can live only in the forest

cards.name: Historian
cards.describe: Birds named after a person (a name with 's)

cards.describe: Birds with a wingspan over 65 cm

cards.name: Nest Box Builder
cards.describe: Birds with a cavity (or star) nest

cards.describe: Birds with a wild food icon in their cost

cards.name: Oologist

cards.name: Passerine Specialist

cards.name: Photographer

cards.name: Platform Builder

goals._note: 8 double-sided tiles (rules.md W1.2). Each goal: what is counted at the end of the round (W12.4). Green side points per round [1st, 2nd, 3rd]; blue side: 1 per item, max 5.
